parameters.name: handlingUnit
parameters.description: EACH, CASE or PALLET. Resolves the standard that applies to this handling unit (the unit's own standard, else the task-type-only one). Absent or empty means the task-type-only standard.

schema.description: The packaging level a standard is declared for, and that a completed task handled (ADR 0035). INNER is deliberately absent: no flow implements it in v1.
schema.title: HandlingUnit

parameters.name: siteCode
parameters.description: A site code (1-32 characters, no whitespace; ADR 0038). Reads the open standard of exactly that site, 404 when it has none; never falls back to the site-less standard. Absent or empty means the site-less standard, as before.

schema.description: The facility (facility-layout site code) a standard is scoped to (ADR 0038): 1-32 characters with no Unicode White_Space code point anywhere — exactly what the domain constructor shared.NewSiteCode enforces, so the schema and the constructor cannot drift. The pattern spells the refused set out (U+0009-U+000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000-U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000) because `\S` is engine-dependent: ECMA-262 admits U+0085, Schemathesis's generation admitted U+00A0/U+0085/U+000B, and those schema-valid-but-domain-refused values made the contract job fail at random (CI run 44738035745). Absent means the site-less standard that applies to every site. Declarative input: this service never looks a site up in a sibling context.
schema.title: SiteCode
